## What changes and why?

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior and any related issue.
For documentation changes, describe what readers can now understand or do.

## Verification

List the commands run and their results. State what was not checked and why.
For capture changes, include architecture, glibc version and the affected native
cases. Link relevant evidence without exposing sensitive workload data.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe changes to CLI behavior, exit codes, schemas or supported environments.
Link updated documentation and the changelog entry when relevant, or state that
there is no public behavior change.

- [ ] The change is focused and follows the contributing guide.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed, or limitations are explained above.
- [ ] Added or changed evidence retains its provenance and raw diagnostics.
